# Synthetic parity fixture (`synthetic-1`)

This directory contains the committed visual-regression corpus for
`tests/parity_fidelity_tests.rs`.

| Path | Origin |
| :--- | :--- |
| `synthetic-1.pptx` | Generated by `tests/golden/gen_synthetic_parity_deck.js`. Three 16:9 slides of generic text, shapes, a table and a chart. No third-party media, fonts or templates. |
| `reference/synthetic-1/slide-1..3.png` | Locked outputs of this project's renderer at 1280 px. The baseline is approved output, not an independent fidelity oracle. |
| `tests/parity/scores/synthetic-1.json` | Ratchet baseline keyed by `slide-1` … `slide-3`. |

All files in this directory are covered by the repository's MIT licence.

## Why the upstream demo deck was removed

The earlier `sample-1` fixture came from the MIT-licensed
[`office-open-xml-viewer`](https://github.com/yukiyokotani/office-open-xml-viewer)
demo. That deck embeds eight JPEG files with no attribution, caption, EXIF
author or licence statement. The upstream project does not document their
origin, so the deck and its derived reference PNGs were removed from this
repository and its history. The current fixture is synthetic and contains no
third-party photographic media.

## The baseline is a change detector

The reference PNGs are produced by this renderer, so matching them means
"renders like the approved revision", not "matches PowerPoint". The harness
still uses the same pixelmatch settings as the upstream VRT:

- `threshold = 0.20`, `includeAA: true`;
- both images are padded on white to a common `max(w) × max(h)` size;
- a slide fails when its diff exceeds 20 %;
- a missing score fails;
- a drop of more than 0.5 pt below the recorded score fails.

## Regenerating the corpus

```sh
# Regenerate the synthetic deck (requires Node; pptxgenjs is in tests/golden)
cd crates/office-terminal-core/tests/golden
npm ci
node gen_synthetic_parity_deck.js
cd -

# Lock new reference PNGs from the current renderer, then record scores.
UPDATE_REFS=1   cargo test -p office-terminal-core --test parity_fidelity_tests -- --nocapture
UPDATE_SCORES=1 cargo test -p office-terminal-core --test parity_fidelity_tests -- --nocapture
```

`UPDATE_REFS` intentionally does not update scores in the same run; follow it
with `UPDATE_SCORES=1` and review the score delta. The two modes are mutually
exclusive.

## Fonts

Text metrics depend on the bundled Carlito/Caladea/Nunito Sans faces under
`crates/office-terminal-core/assets/fonts/`. A large unexpected drop usually
means a face substitution, not a renderer regression.
